avoid_supplements.name: Alcohol/Ethanol
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; alcohol inhibits metabolism and increases diphenhydramine levels
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated—counsel patient to completely avoid alcohol during diphenhydramine use

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer reduces diphenhydramine efficacy; may decrease antihistamine effect
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor for reduced symptom control; consider alternative antihistamine

avoid_supplements.name: Jimsonweed (Datura)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive anticholinergic effects; risk of severe anticholinergic toxicity (urinary retention, glaucoma, tachycardia, confusion)

caution_supplements.name: Valerian Root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression effects; may increase sedation and drowsiness
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; counsel patient on increased sedation risk; avoid driving/operating machinery

caution_supplements.name: Passionflower
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive drowsiness; advise patient to separate dosing or reduce concurrent use if sedation problematic

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may marginally increase diphenhydramine levels
caution_supplements.action: Counsel moderation; excessive consumption may increase anticholinergic side effects

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay absorption and onset of action due to slowed gastric emptying
caution_foods.action: Take diphenhydramine on empty stomach or with light meal for optimal absorption; space dosing away from large fatty meals

monitoring_notes: Monitor for excessive sedation, anticholinergic effects (dry mouth, urinary retention, blurred vision, constipation), and CNS depression, particularly in elderly patients and those with concurrent medications affecting CYP2D6/3A4. Counsel on fall risk and impaired cognition; avoid driving or hazardous activities until individual tolerance established.
